# stapel-delivery 0.1.0

Delivery methods (courier, pickup point, digital), zones matched by country / region / postcode prefix, rates (flat, free above a subtotal, per kilogram when cart lines carry attrs.weight_grams), pickup points with hours and coordinates, a per-user address book with one default, and shipments with a table FSM (pending, packed, shipped, delivered, returned, cancelled), a timeline, tracking number and link. It is the stapel-orders shipping adjuster (delivery.quote, kind shipping, order 200; honours a promotion's meta.free_shipping marker) and a checkout hook (delivery.reserve keeps the validated choice and the address snapshot under the checkout attempt key; commit creates the order's shipment; release on cancel cancels it). Carriers are a strategy registry: manual by default, an auto-advancing mock for prototypes, a documented Carrier ABC for real ones.

Contract: axes 2 · surface 9 · extension points 12 · operations 14 · error codes 53 · flows 4.
Generated from docs/capabilities.json by `stapel-llms-txt` — do not edit; drift-gated by `make contract-check`.

## Configuration axes — what a product switches on
Settings keys; `default` is what you get by saying nothing. Turning an axis off unmounts the operations it gates.
- DEFAULT_CARRIER [enum, default "manual"] — Who moves parcels
  manual (default): staff record the tracking number and move each shipment. mock: shipments advance to delivered by themselves every few minutes, for demos and prototypes only. A real carrier registers its own name. Values: manual, mock.
- REQUIRE_METHOD [bool, default true] — Delivery must be chosen
  true (default): a checkout without a delivery choice is refused with error.400.delivery_method_required (unless nothing in the cart ships). false: such a checkout simply has no shipping line and no shipment. Values: true, false.

## Usage surface — call these before writing your own
This is the answer to "does Stapel already have something for X?". `instead of` names the outside symbol this one displaces.
### predicate
- carrier_names — stapel_delivery.carriers.carrier_names
  The slugs a method and DEFAULT_CARRIER accept (built-ins <- settings <- runtime); also the environment vocabulary.
- uses_mock — stapel_delivery.carriers.uses_mock
  Where the mock carrier is in use (DEFAULT_CARRIER, and with methods=True the method codes); what the posture checks E002/W002 read.
### factory
- carrier_by_slug — stapel_delivery.carriers.carrier_by_slug
  A shipment's carrier for polling and links; an unregistered slug falls back to manual instead of failing the beat.
- carrier_for_method — stapel_delivery.carriers.carrier_for_method
  A method's own carrier, or the default — what a new shipment of that method gets.
- default_carrier — stapel_delivery.carriers.default_carrier
  The carrier this deployment uses for methods without their own (delivery_settings.DEFAULT_CARRIER).
- get_carrier — stapel_delivery.carriers.get_carrier
  The carrier registered under a slug; ImproperlyConfigured when unknown.
- register_carrier — stapel_delivery.carriers.register_carrier
  Register (or with None remove) a carrier class under a slug from an AppConfig.ready(); methods and DEFAULT_CARRIER may then name it. The settings twin is STAPEL_DELIVERY['CARRIERS'].
- reset_carriers — stapel_delivery.carriers.reset_carriers
  Drop runtime carrier registrations — a test lever.
- resolve_carrier — stapel_delivery.carriers.resolve_carrier
  Turn a DEFAULT_CARRIER value (slug or dotted path) into a carrier; the AppSettings resolver for the key.

## Extension points — what a product replaces, fork-free
- CARRIERS [merge_registry]
  Carrier strategies by slug: {slug: 'dotted.path.Carrier' | None} merged over the built-ins manual and mock (or register_carrier at runtime). A Carrier registers a parcel (tracking number), polls status updates from the beat and renders a tracking link; a push-style carrier's webhook calls services.shipments.apply_carrier_update.
- DEFAULT_CARRIER [strategy]
  The carrier a method without its own carrier uses: manual (default), mock (prototype posture only, check E002/W002) or a registered slug / dotted path.
- GEOCODE_FUNCTION [setting]
  A comm Function with the geo.geocode contract that fills missing coordinates of a saved address after commit, best-effort; empty = off.
- STAPEL_DELIVERY_ADDRESS_PRESENTER / STAPEL_DELIVERY_METHOD_PRESENTER / STAPEL_DELIVERY_OPTIONS_PRESENTER / STAPEL_DELIVERY_PICKUP_POINT_PRESENTER / STAPEL_DELIVERY_SHIPMENT_PRESENTER [presenter]
  Swap keys (STAPEL_SWAP) for every response presenter, so a host changes what the API shows without forking a view.
- delivery.options [comm_function]
  Every enabled method with its price for a cart and a destination (country is enough), with the reason a method is not offered.
- delivery.quote [comm_function]
  The orders shipping adjuster: reads context.delivery {method, address | address_id | pickup_point}, answers one shipping adjustment (0.00 when free) or a refusal error key; no personal data in meta.
- delivery.reserve / delivery.commit / delivery.release [comm_function]
  The orders checkout hook: reserve stores the choice and the address snapshot under the attempt key; commit binds it to the order and creates the shipment; release drops it, or on an order cancel cancels a shipment that has not left. Idempotent on the attempt key.
- delivery.shipment.created [comm_event]
  A placed order got its shipment: ids, method, carrier, status, shipping amount; never the recipient.
- delivery.shipment.status [comm_function]
  A shipment's status and tracking for another service, by order_id or shipment_id; no recipient fields.
- delivery.shipment.status_changed [comm_event]
  Every shipment move with the actor (staff, carrier, system) and the tracking number; feeds the buyer notification.
- orders.order.placed [comm_event]
  Consumed: creates the order's shipment from the checkout intent when the commit hook has not already done it.
- orders.order.status_changed [comm_event]
  Consumed: an order moved to cancelled cancels its pending or packed shipment.

## Fits with — fleet dependencies
- stapel-auth (optional) — addresses and shipments are keyed on request.user; user.merged moves a guest's book and shipments to the account on sign-in
- stapel-core (required) — comm bus (delivery.* Functions and emits, orders.* and user.merged consumers), AnchorPagination, GDPR owner protocol, posture stage, AppSettings
- stapel-geo (optional) — GEOCODE_FUNCTION = 'geo.geocode' fills coordinates of saved addresses, by Function name only
- stapel-notifications (optional) — delivers delivery.shipment_status_changed to the buyer
- stapel-orders (optional) — calls delivery.quote as its shipping adjuster and delivery.reserve/commit/release as a checkout hook (preset.SETTINGS_DEFAULTS), and emits orders.order.placed / status_changed that create and cancel shipments
- stapel-promotions (optional) — a free-shipping promotion marks its adjustment meta.free_shipping, which delivery.quote honours

## HTTP operations (14) — call by operationId, never by a typed path
Paths are relative to `/delivery/api/v1/`.
### Delivery
- POST /addresses/ — delivery_addresses_create
- DELETE /addresses/{address_id}/ — delivery_addresses_destroy
- GET /addresses/ — delivery_addresses_list
- POST /addresses/{address_id}/default/ — delivery_addresses_make_default
- PATCH /addresses/{address_id}/ — delivery_addresses_partial_update
- GET /addresses/{address_id}/ — delivery_addresses_retrieve
- GET /methods/ — delivery_methods_list
- POST /options/ — delivery_options_create
- GET /pickup-points/ — delivery_pickup_points_list
- GET /shipments/ — delivery_shipments_list
- GET /shipments/{shipment_id}/ — delivery_shipments_retrieve
- GET /staff/shipments/ — delivery_staff_shipments_list
- POST /staff/shipments/{shipment_id}/tracking/ — delivery_staff_shipments_tracking
- POST /staff/shipments/{shipment_id}/transition/ — delivery_staff_shipments_transition
